name: Haneyama Reiko
source:
"Are you trying to ruin this company?"

Tetsuo's boss.

Ruthless, overbearing, and ambitious, she'll stop at nothing to advance her career.

She tolerates the "Last Train Plan" for the sake of the company, but if push comes to shove, she's prepared to fire all employees involved in the plan.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/chikandensya/chikan_top.htm]Official Site[/url]
